_comment: SHIVAN GORGE WITH TWO UNTAP SLOTS: the button must NOT appear, and the arithmetic is why.
A Gorge ping has {T} in its cost, so it is once-per-untap, and ApplyBlinkLoop promotes the
damage sink to the FRONT of the untap priority precisely so the loop gets it back. Cloud of
Faeries untaps TWO lands, so one slot is the Gorge (yield 1) and exactly one is a yield land
(Kitchen, 5). The iteration therefore budgets 5 + 1 = 6 against the blink's {2}{C} (3) plus
the ping's {2}{R} (3): net ZERO. The loop coasts on its opening float and stops.
Measured before the fix, with the branch sizing `life` iterations off an unreserved refund:
opponent life 20 -> 20 blinks, 10 pings, no kill; life 5 -> 5 blinks, 3 pings, no kill. The
GORGE rule was offered 17 times across the sweep and won ZERO of them
MTG_COMBO_OFF_GORGE_SLOT reserves the slot the sink will take, so the branch declines and the
board is honestly absent. The POSITIVE control is edf_co_13: the identical board with
Peregrine Drake instead of Cloud -- five untap slots, so the Gorge AND four yield lands come
back -- which is offered and wins.
